poisson_spatial_q2_seed147 -- scale-300 campaign dataset (poisson_spatial, seed 147; R-generated,
64 sites, 16 rows each). With the single default start the Poisson `spatial(1 + x | g)` SD
regression stopped at a genuine stationary point 1.02 log-lik below the best one (slope
fixed effect 0.94 instead of 0.25); native drmTMB 0.8.1 reaches the higher one
(logLik -1573.120983211433). `coords.csv` is the campaign site table. Numbers and data only;
no drmTMB source is vendored.
